question: How should the command gṛhṇāpaya and the word mama be placed in the mantra?
premises: The command gṛhṇāpaya must be said twice.
The word mama must be included.
These occur at the end of all words.
inference: Say gṛhṇāpaya twice and place mama at the end of all words.
plain_english: Having said 'gṛhṇāpaya' twice, place 'mama' at the end of all the words.
